hints.content: Imagine that the plane slices the solid figure.  The slice cuts through the prism horizontally so the shape of the slice is the same as the shape of the base of the prism.
Since the base of the prism is a pentagon, the shape of the horizontal slice is also a pentagon.

The shape of a horizontal intersection with the prism is a pentagon.  


[[☃ image 1]]

question.content:
The figure below shows a right regular prism whose base is a pentagon.



[[☃ image 1]]

**Which shape does the intersection of the horizontal plane with the prism look like?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A pentagonal prism with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is parallel to an base of the pentagonal prism. The rectangle moves through the entire pentagonal prism showing every possible cross-section. It cross-section includes a pentagon.
